probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Nine days in the salt pans Date 18 September 2022 Topic Site notes Length 1 min read Next: Printing wood into concrete The salt pans can only be worked between the end of the harvest and the first autumn rain. That gave us nine days. No steel Salt eats steel. Every joint in the pavilion is timber on timber, held with oak pegs that the carpenters cut on site from a single beam. The last day We fixed the final roof board at six in the evening, as the first clouds came in from the sea. It rained for a week. The pavilion has been dry underneath ever since. © 2026 Dario Castelli Milan, --:-- Terms Privacy Cookies Overview
